text:
maya: quick heads-up — i'm primary for the 14:00-18:00 window but stuck in an airport. flight delayed, need to hand primary off for ~90m during a traffic surge. @rajesh can you take primary?
oncall-bot: Pager #3872 posted 1768881228 — high error rate on /v1/generate (us-west1) :rotating_light:
rajesh: I can take primary for 90m. where's the latest runbook pointer? maya any active mitigations?
maya: thanks. Mitigations in flight: rolling fallback to model-slim in us-west route, autoscaler scaled up. cache warm-up at ~80% hit. runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/latency-surge
rajesh: got it. customer-impact? which flows?
maya: realtime features for customer-acme showing 5xx and high latency. SLO alert fired. pager has trace ids. quick logs pasted below:
```
[2026-05-01T14:10:23Z] svc-gateway 500 GET /v1/generate conn=us-west1 shards=2 err=kv-cache-miss
[2026-05-01T14:11:02Z] autoscaler scale_to=12 -> 20 replicas due to cpu
```
ops-bot: Canary rollback scheduled for 14:20; version=prod-v2 -> prod-v1 ; user=maya
rajesh: ok i'll start rollback check. @tess can you shadow telemetry (p50/p95/token burn) while i operate?
tess: on it — opening dashboards. p50 -> 320ms, p95 -> 1.8s, token burn ~2.4x baseline :chart_with_upwards_trend:
rajesh: steps from runbook i'll follow:
1) pause new canary traffic
2) update route policy: `route set us-west1 -> prod-v1, fallback prod-v2`
3) monitor for 5 minutes and check errors/traces
rajesh: executing now:
```
redwood route update --region us-west1 --primary prod-v1 --fallback prod-v2
```
oncall-bot: command accepted — job id 48822 (executor: runway)
leo: ping — if rollback doesn't reduce errors in 5m we'll trigger emergency scale and open a bridge
maya: i'm handing primary to @rajesh now. i'm available via DM but offline for phone. leaving pager for ~90m. thanks :pray:
rajesh: ack i'm primary. will post status update in 10m. incident-scribe please capture notes :memo:
ops-bot: Incident CN-1152 created; severity=sev2; assignee=rajesh
rajesh: rollback in progress — checking error rate and traces
(t+3m) tess: error rate down to ~1.3x baseline, p95 down to ~1.1s — still above normal but trending
rajesh: nice. continuing to monitor. if error rate <1.2x after 5m we'll keep routing and watch for 30m stability window
maya: thanks team, ETA for me back online ~60-90m. appreciate the quick takeover and runbook ops :shipit:
rajesh: copying runbook links: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/latency-surge#rollback
rajesh: final for now — errors trending down, will keep as primary until maya confirms back or we hit stable window. will escalate if >2x persists.
